description: Newberry's Blueberries grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 387 NC Hwy 53 E, NC. The farm is small, and its seasons run through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
